editionLabel: English refresh edition · 2021 credits, eight voting dials
firstPlayerRule: Whoever comes up with a clue for a card first becomes the opening storyteller.
houseFallback: If nobody wants to offer the first clue, your group can agree to choose a storyteller randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: After a turn, the storyteller role moves to the player on the current storyteller’s left.

sources.title: Dixit — refreshed English rulebook
sources.location: PDF page 2, How to play opening sentence and End of turn; PDF page 1, Credits 2021

internalEvidence: The English rulebook linked by https://www.libellud.com/en/resources/dixit/ says the first person to find a clue becomes the first storyteller. The How to play page was visually inspected. Page 1 labels the credits 2021; the component list shows eight dials.
uncertainty: No explicit simultaneous-clue tie-break appears in this opening instruction.
Do not substitute a youngest-player rule or assume all Dixit products use this instruction.
